title: Make Forget a complete user-facing operation
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published head and normal hook results recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack on reviewed F18. Uses the canonical turn identity and existing stream/use projection contracts. No unmerged Q implementation imported.

baseline_review.comparison: Facts and extractor blobs unchanged across audit, initial main and parent. Final main fetch adds no vault/brief/AgentService/WS changes. Parent head unchanged. No F19 branch/PR existed; concurrent F/D/Q work inspected.
baseline_review.parent_ci: All active F18 checks pass; conditional jobs skipped. Prior reviewer recommendation: Approve, no findings.

figma.visual: Backend contract only; D track owns confirmation UI. No screenshot claimed.

activation.independence: New Forget requests do not require F18 activation; existing tombstones remain enforced with all Brief flags off.

implementation: Authenticated no-store GET prepares exact source revision and scope or recovers a receipt. Explicit confirmed POST atomically records suppression, deletes selected fact/evidence, and reconciles surviving facts.
Content-free durable receipts deduplicate retries. Request-identity reuse and concurrent correction return clear conflicts; failures and capacity exhaustion leave the fact intact.

Database-local HMAC suppression covers extraction, profile synchronization and goal-completion replay. Legacy missing provenance fails conservatively; later canonical user input/manual correction can create a new fact.
Matching profile source fields are withheld from prompt projections without deleting editable settings. Existing F17 cursors become stale and F18 immutable event history marks forgotten IDs.

Provider-handoff fences reject prepared forgotten fact/profile context in Brief/workflows and legacy AgentService chat/image/voice-classifier paths, independently of usage logging. Async streams retain capture scope.
Bounded 10000 durable receipts, 100000 suppression keys and 1000 evidence rows per mutation; no suppression expiry or silent eviction.

verification.guards: Normal commit hooks required before push; exact results recorded in PR description.
verification.evidence_policy: Committed logs contain test verdicts only; raw local fixture output is not published.

limitations: Only the chosen assertion and its evidence are deleted. Original messages/summaries/documents, settings/interview sources, entity identity/relationships, independently stored facts and backups remain.

Suppression matches normalized assertions and known source revisions, not arbitrary semantic paraphrases. Legacy sources without a revision use conservative automatic-writer suppression; new manual input or a later canonical Brief turn can override by creating new information.
A matching profile source field is withheld as a whole. This may withhold other text in that field until the answer changes; unrelated facts are not erased.
Already-sent provider context, existing realtime sessions, tool-return copies, backups and SQLite free pages cannot be scrubbed by this operation. No global model unlearning or secure file erasure.
No Undo, suppression expiry or silent capacity eviction. No UI, deployment, production activation or F20 implementation. Full repository CI reports separately.
rollback: Unset JARVIS_BRIEF_MEMORY_FORGET and restart to disable new requests. Keep durable tombstones and ingestion/handoff checks. A pre-F19 writer can ignore suppression and must not be substituted after using Forget without preserving these checks.

review_fixes.R1: Persist a random per-field profile edit identity only when the normalized answer changes. Changed-back answers, clear/re-entry, derived aliases and canonical profile corrections restore new input. Unrelated saves, legacy settings and prepared old contexts remain suppressed.
review_fixes.R2: Persist the text-pair replay alias alongside scoped extraction evidence and suppress both on Forget. Enrich existing evidence on re-ingestion without duplication, preserve aliases through restart and advance shared alias ownership on repeated Forget.

regressions.after_fix: All eight cases pass in the focused and affected suites recorded below.

review_fixes.schema: One nullable replay_source_ref evidence column and a field-to-random-revision table. Additive, no source answer text in revision metadata.
